assumptions.choice: The bar on which the buy order is filled counts as day 0; the position is closed once the bar count since that fill reaches 5 (i.e., on the 5th trading day after entry).
assumptions.reason: The spec states 'close the position 5 trading days after entry' but does not define whether entry day counts as day zero or day one; day-zero counting from the actual fill bar is the most literal reading.
